Welcome to the Presenter Scorecard

This is your live weekly qualification tracker. Every presenter sees everyone's status, so you know where the whole team stands at a glance — and whether the collective has triggered a disbursement at the 200-subscriber milestone.

How to use it. Log in with your show name and the shared password. Your own card lights up with an amber border and an edit panel — update your numbers any time, save, done. Other cards stay read-only for you. Data syncs to Google Sheets via Apps Script and the dashboard auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.

What you're updating. The 10 criteria that map directly to Section 5 & 8.3 of your Presenter Agreement — show production, social posts across all platforms, featured-artist tags, SSR app promo, community engagement, and Stripe Connect. If you hit all 10, you qualify for that week's share of the disbursement pool.

Artist shoutouts. Log each artist you've shouted out this week. Your shoutouts appear in the team-wide feed at the bottom so artists see the recognition.

Admin fields. Production quality checks and Stripe Connect verification are managed by SSR — you'll see your status on those but won't have edit controls.

Questions? info@sonicscoutradio.com

⚠ Configuration needed: The dashboard hasn't been wired to Google Sheets yet. Open the HTML and paste your Apps Script Web App URL into SCORECARD_WORKER_URL near the top of the <script> block.

The Ask — qualification criteria (tap to read)

All presenters must meet every criterion in the 7-day rolling Qualification Period to receive a Disbursement payment. No partial payouts, no carry-forward.

Weekly Show Production
  • 1 fully produced show, minimum 60 min
  • Uploaded within 24h of allocated slot
  • 44.1kHz / 16-bit minimum audio
  • Every track tagged with title, artist, timestamp
  • Presenter commentary on track intros
Social Media Promotion
  • 3–5 posts per week (Instagram primary)
  • 1+ show promotion post weekly
  • 1+ face-to-camera / self-video weekly
  • 1+ featured-artist tag weekly
  • 1+ SSR app promo monthly
Community + Admin
  • Discord post or reply weekly
  • Reply to artist messages within 48h
  • Support fellow presenters (shares, comments)
  • Stripe Connect active + verified
